reconciliation.label: Published rounding
reconciliation.note: The MOF publishes NIRC and overall budget balance to the nearest S$1 million. This difference reconciles those rounded figures with the more precise revenue and expenditure estimates. It is not government spending.

notes: Programme detail uses the official Total Expenditure by Programme tables. Programme allocations are not complete agency financial statements. Broad published programmes remain broad; no undisclosed department split is inferred.
Flows show a pooled budget. Revenue sources are not earmarked to the ministries they visually connect to.

Ministry figures are total expenditure by sector from the MOF summary, excluding loans, land-related expenditure and other non-expenditure outlays. Manpower and Digital Development and Information are split across sectors by programme; their portions are not whole-ministry totals.
Special transfers include fund top-ups, not subsequent spending from those funds. Counting both would double count.
Land sales and borrowing are not operating revenue. Net Investment Returns Contribution is included separately; gross investment and interest income is not added.
The overall budget balance precedes SINGA capitalisation and financing adjustments. The overall fiscal position includes those adjustments.

Fees and charges include vehicle quota premiums (COE). They are combined to preserve the exact published category total. Changes in scope make FY2025/FY2026 fees and other revenue comparisons unsuitable without adjustment.
Widths use source amounts in Singapore dollars. Displayed billions and percentages are rounded.
